meta.title: AU to pc Converter — Astronomical Unit to Parsec
meta.description: Convert Astronomical Unit (AU) to Parsec (pc) instantly. 1 AU = 4.848102e-6 pc. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert astronomical units (AU) to parsecs (pc) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each astronomical unit equals 4.848102e-6 parsecs. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One astronomical unit is equal to **4.848102e-6 parsecs**. To go the other way, one parsec equals **206270 astronomical units**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> parsecs = astronomical units × 4.848102e-6

Worked example — converting 10 astronomical units:

10 × 4.848102e-6 = **4.848102e-5 pc**.

To invert, divide by 4.848102e-6 (or multiply by 206270).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 AU ≈ 4.848102e-6 pc. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Astronomical Unit and Parsec both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many parsecs are in 1 astronomical unit?
**A:** 4.848102e-6 parsecs.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert AU to pc?
**A:** parsecs = astronomical units × 4.848102e-6.

**Q:** How do I convert pc back to AU?
**A:** Multiply by 206270 (or divide by 4.848102e-6).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this AU to pc converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
